capabilities: Detect the first image, YouTube link, or Auto Card Link in a note
Set a frontmatter property with the featured image path or link
Download external images and generate resized thumbnails locally
Bulk set, update, or remove featured images across the vault
Delete downloaded images and thumbnails no longer referenced by notes
extras: The README states that since Notebook Navigator 2.0, thumbnail generation is built into that plugin and Featured Image is no longer needed for it; the author solicits donations via Buy Me a Coffee and GitHub Sponsors.
intentEvidence: Show image previews in database table views without network delays (Obsidian 1.9+)
motivation: It was originally built to generate image thumbnails for Notebook Navigator, though that plugin now handles thumbnails itself.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to automatically give every note an image property for image previews in Bases tables, Dataview queries, or file browsers.

relations.evidence: Before Notebook Navigator version 2.0 was released this was the preferred way
Dataview - Include thumbnails in custom queries with fast local image access
Obsidian Bases - Show image previews in database table views without network delays

summary: Plugin that automatically sets a featured image frontmatter property from a note's first image, YouTube link, or Auto Card Link, with optional thumbnails.
